name: merge-forge
description: Resolve Git merge conflicts in a JetBrains/WebStorm-style three-pane visual merge editor.

walkthroughs.title: Resolve merges the JetBrains way
walkthroughs.description: Three panes, gutter arrows, and an AI that reads your repo.

steps.title: Open a conflicted file
steps.description:
When a merge or rebase hits conflicts, the Conflicts dialog opens automatically — or pick a file yourself.
[Open a Conflicted File](command:mergeForge.resolve)

steps.title: Resolve with the gutter controls
steps.description: Click » or « to accept a side, × to ignore it, or the wand to apply everything non-conflicting. F7 steps through changes; the result pane is fully editable.

steps.title: Set up the AI assistant
steps.description:
With GitHub Copilot it works out of the box. Otherwise pick a provider and paste a key — then ✦ explains conflicts and ▶ fixes the whole file.
[Set AI Provider & Key](command:mergeForge.setApiKey)

media.altText: AI explanation with live tool activity

mergeForge.autoOpenOnConflict.description: Automatically open the Merge Forge editor when opening a file with merge conflicts.

mergeForge.autoShowConflicts.description: Open the Conflicts dialog automatically when a merge, rebase, or cherry-pick hits conflicts.

mergeForge.lineEnding.description: Line ending used for the merge result when the sides disagree. "auto" prefers your local side's dominant line ending.

mergeForge.autoApplyNonConflicting.description: Apply all non-conflicting changes automatically when the merge editor opens.

mergeForge.autoAdvance.description: After applying a resolved file, open the next conflicted file immediately instead of showing a notification.

enumDescriptions: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (OpenRouter, Ollama, proxies) — set mergeForge.ai.customBaseUrl and customModel
mergeForge.ai.provider.description: AI provider used by "Explain conflicts with AI" when the editor offers no models of its own. Set up with the "Merge Forge: Set AI Provider & API Key" command.

mergeForge.ai.model.description: Model for AI explanations. "auto" uses the active provider's default (see mergeForge.ai.provider); any other value overrides it. The VS Code Language Model API path uses your Copilot model instead.

mergeForge.ai.customBaseUrl.description: Base URL of the Custom OpenAI-compatible endpoint, e.g. http://localhost:11434/v1 for Ollama or https://openrouter.ai/api/v1. Only used when mergeForge.ai.provider is "custom".

mergeForge.ai.customModel.description: Model ID for the Custom endpoint (mergeForge.ai.model "auto" resolves to this when the provider is "custom").
